覆纹取每条被记录原伤害的实际来源角色；浸染取 12 秒区间内每条受益伤害自己的来: Hexed takes the actual source character of each recorded original damage instance; Stain takes each benefiting hit's own source character within the 12-second window. The QTE character who triggered the Cycle only triggers it and does not permanently provide the Cycle Intensity for later hits.
创生/黯星/浊燃由比较胜出角色提供；覆纹/浸染由实际伤害来源角色提供。每张环合卡: Blossom/Nova/Scorch are provided by the character that wins the comparison; Hexed/Stain by the actual damage source character. Each Cycle card lists these item by item.
敌方防御、对应伤害属性抗性、动态减抗和受到伤害提升；不从中文怪物名猜取。: Enemy DEF, resistance to the matching damage type, dynamic RES reduction and DMG taken increase; never inferred from Chinese monster names.
源档 = floor((归属角色等级 - 1) ÷ 5)；1–5 级取源档 0，: Source tier = floor((attributed character level - 1) ÷ 5); levels 1–5 use source tier 0 and levels 76–80 use source tier 15.
这是静态库中独立存在的第二条创生曲线。资源名后缀不能作为角色归属证据，因此图鉴只: This is a second, independently existing Blossom curve in the static database. Since the asset name suffix cannot serve as evidence of character attribution, the catalog shows it only as "Blossom Special Entry".
静态库中另有残虹专属浊燃曲线；当前 16 档与普通浊燃完全相同，但仍按独立正式来: The static database also contains a Zankou-exclusive Scorch curve; its 16 tiers are currently identical to regular Scorch, but it is still shown as an independent formal source.
表内数字来自当前发行静态库的正式 16 档曲线；公式如何消费这些数字仍以各环合卡: The numbers in this table come from the formal 16-tier curves of the current release static database; how the formulas consume them is still governed by each Cycle card.
等级基础值 × 环合强度区 × 防御 × 抗性 × 易伤；不暴击。: Level base value × Cycle Intensity zone × DEF × RES × vulnerability; no CRIT.
单朵创生伤害 = 向下取整[等级基础值 × (1 + 环合强度/600) × 防: Single Blossom damage = floor[level base value × (1 + Cycle Intensity/600) × DEF zone × RES zone × vulnerability zone]
从两名环合参与者中选出归属角色。: Select the attributed character from the two Cycle participants.
按归属角色等级读取创生 16 档基础值。: Read the Blossom 16-tier base value for the attributed character's level.
使用归属角色的环合强度和目标侧防御/属性抗性。: Use the attributed character's Cycle Intensity and the target's DEF/elemental resistance.
乘目标易伤后，在最终出口向下取整。: Multiply by the target's vulnerability, then floor at the final output.
取两名环合参与者中“环合强度 × 等级基础值”较高者。: Take the higher "Cycle Intensity × level base value" of the two Cycle participants.
取归属角色等级对应的创生源档；80 级为 9,000。: Take the Blossom source tier for the attributed character's level; at level 80 it is 9,000.
取归属角色命中时的环合强度，不取另一名参与者，也不相加。: Take the attributed character's Cycle Intensity at the moment of the hit; do not take the other participant's and do not add them together.
角色等级与防御穿透取归属角色；防御属性和防御降低取受击目标。: Character level and DEF penetration come from the attributed character; DEF attribute and DEF reduction come from the target hit.
伤害属性由正式逐击/伤害项确认；穿透取归属角色，抗性与减抗取受击目标。: The damage element is confirmed by the formal per-hit/damage entry; penetration comes from the attributed character, and resistance and RES reduction come from the target hit.
取受击目标在该时点的受到伤害提升。: Take the target's DMG taken increase at that moment.
创生不读取攻击/生命/防御面板，不读取通用或属性增伤，不暴击。: Blossom does not read the ATK/HP/DEF panel, does not read generic or elemental DMG bonus, and does not crit.
一个创生株生成 5 个创生花、最多 3 株属于状态与命中数量，不乘进单朵公式。: One Blossom Stalk generates 5 Blossom Flowers, up to 3 stalks; these belong to the state and hit count and are not multiplied into the single-flower formula.
记录符合条件的灵/咒实际伤害，12 秒结束时按原伤属性追加。: Records qualifying Anima/Incantation actual damage and appends it with the original damage's element at the end of 12 seconds.
记录每条符合条件的灵/咒实际伤害及其属性；正式 DOT 等被记录来源同样适用。: Records each qualifying Anima/Incantation actual damage instance and its element; recorded sources such as formal DOTs apply as well.
基础复制比例加上灵可复制比例加成，再乘以一加追击增伤。: The base copy ratio plus Linko's copy ratio bonus, multiplied by one plus the Follow Up DMG bonus.
用原伤害实际来源角色的环合强度计算强度区；复制部分乘强度区后，再加入强度区减一的: Use the Cycle Intensity of the original damage's actual source character to compute the intensity zone; multiply the copied part by the intensity zone, then add the limit term of intensity zone minus one.
将原伤害实际值乘以上述合计和最终乘数，继承该条原伤害的属性。: Multiply the original damage's actual value by the above total and the final multiplier, inheriting that original damage instance's element.
12 秒结束时分别追加，再在最终出口取整。: Append each separately at the end of 12 seconds, then round at the final output.
取被覆纹记录的那一条真实伤害；不重新用预计面板生成。: Take the real damage instance recorded by Hexed; do not regenerate it from an estimated panel.
继承每条原伤害的攻击方属性：灵伤仍是灵，咒伤仍是咒。: Inherits each original damage instance's attacking element: Anima damage stays Anima, Incantation damage stays Incantation.
取被记录原伤害的实际来源角色；不取触发覆纹的 QTE 角色，也不比较环合双方。: Take the actual source character of the recorded original damage; do not take the QTE character who triggered Hexed, and do not compare the two Cycle participants.
队伍启用灵可“弱点感应”时为 10%，未启用时为 0%。: 10% when the team enables Linko's "Weakness Radar", and 0% otherwise.
本页按弱点感应启用时 10%、未启用时 0% 拆分；只乘复制部分，不乘后面的限制: This page splits it as 10% when Weakness Radar is enabled and 0% otherwise; it multiplies only the copied part, not the limit term that follows.
保留原伤害已经结算的增伤，不除掉原增伤区；若原伤本身已吃到追击增伤，其收益保留在: Keeps the DMG bonus already settled on the original damage and does not divide out the original bonus zone; if the original damage already received the Follow Up bonus, that gain stays in the actual value.
当前核心模型取 1；不重复乘入原伤的最终增伤。: The current core model takes 1; the original damage's final bonus is not multiplied in again.
覆纹不读取环合 16 档基础伤害表；它以已发生并被正式记录的实际伤害为基数。: Hexed does not read the Cycle 16-tier base damage table; its base is actual damage that already occurred and was formally recorded.
这是当前 33% 结果的拆分解释，尚未独立确认游戏内部按这两个 10% 分步结算: This is a breakdown of the current 33% result; it is not yet independently confirmed that the game settles these two 10% steps separately, so other Follow Up bonus sources are not substituted in on this basis.
33% 是复制部分合计，最终追加伤害还受环合强度影响，并非固定为原伤的 33%，: 33% is the copied part total; the final appended damage is still affected by Cycle Intensity, so it is not fixed at 33% of the original damage, and the whole Hexed instance is not multiplied by 1.10 again.
状态被提前移除时默认不立刻结算，除非专属效果明确要求。: If the state is removed early it is not settled immediately by default, unless a dedicated effect explicitly requires it.
16 档基础值 × 结算前层数 × 环合强度区 × 目标侧乘区 × DOT/暴击: 16-tier base value × stacks before settlement × Cycle Intensity zone × target-side multipliers × DOT/CRIT.
浊燃单跳 = 向下取整[等级基础值 × 结算前层数 × (1 + 环合强度/60: Scorch per tick = floor[level base value × stacks before settlement × (1 + Cycle Intensity/600) × DEF zone × RES zone × vulnerability zone × DOT-exclusive final zone × CRIT branch]
分别计算两名环合参与者的“等级基础值 × 环合强度”，取较高者作为归属角色。: Compute "level base value × Cycle Intensity" for each of the two Cycle participants and take the higher one as the attributed character.
读取同半场、同目标在本跳前的浊燃层数。: Read the Scorch stacks on the same target in the same half before this tick.
计算环合强度、目标防御/抗性、DOT 专属最终区。: Compute the Cycle Intensity, the target's DEF/RES and the DOT-exclusive final zone.
按固定 50% 暴击策略保留未暴击/暴击分支并最终取整。: Keep the non-crit/crit branches under the fixed 50% CRIT policy, then round at the end.
比较两名环合参与者各自的“等级基础值 × 环合强度”并取较高者；不固定取 QTE: Compare each of the two Cycle participants' "level base value × Cycle Intensity" and take the higher one; the QTE character is not fixed as the source, and the values are not added together.
每名参与者先按自身等级读取适用的浊燃源档；普通与残虹专属曲线当前 80 级均为: Each participant first reads the applicable Scorch source tier for their own level; the regular and Zankou-exclusive curves are both 2,700 at level 80.
普通浊燃固定 1 层；残虹替换状态由同半场、同目标的正式 DOT 施加轴推进，最: Regular Scorch is fixed at 1 stack; the Zankou replacement state is advanced by the formal DOT application axis for the same target in the same half, up to 3 stacks.
每名参与者使用自己的环合强度参与归属比较；胜出后，本次浊燃冻结胜出者的强度与角色: Each participant uses their own Cycle Intensity in the attribution comparison; once one wins, this Scorch instance freezes the winner's Intensity and character-side variables.
角色等级/穿透取归属角色，敌方防御/减防取受击目标。: Character level/penetration come from the attributed character; enemy DEF/DEF reduction come from the target hit.
普通浊燃取逐击确认的实际属性；残虹专属固定取咒属性。穿透取归属角色，抗性取目标。: Regular Scorch takes the actual element confirmed per hit; the Zankou-exclusive one is always Incantation. Penetration comes from the attributed character and resistance from the target.
取命中前目标上仍有效的正式 DOT 种类和明确限定 DOT 的最终增伤。: Takes the formal DOT types still active on the target before the hit and the final DMG bonus explicitly limited to DOTs.
固定暴击率 50%；不读取角色暴击率，但读取归属角色暴击伤害。: Fixed 50% CRIT Rate; the character's CRIT Rate is not read, but the attributed character's CRIT DMG is.
浊燃不读取角色攻击面板，也不读取通用/属性伤害提升。: Scorch does not read the character's ATK panel or generic/elemental DMG increases.
浊燃自身跳伤不递归为残虹浊燃加层；缺少正式施加事件时不能从最终伤害反推任意层数。: Scorch's own tick damage does not recursively add stacks to Zankou Scorch; without a formal application event, stacks must not be inferred backwards from final damage.
5 秒后结算心灵伤害；不走防御区，仍走心灵抗性与易伤。: Settles Mental DMG after 5 seconds; it skips the DEF zone but still applies Mental RES and vulnerability.
单个黯星 = 向下取整[等级基础值 × (1 + 环合强度/600) × 心灵抗: Single Nova = floor[level base value × (1 + Cycle Intensity/600) × Mental RES zone × vulnerability zone]
每次暗+魂触发时分别计算两名参与者的“等级基础值 × 环合强度”。: On each Chaos + Psyche trigger, compute "level base value × Cycle Intensity" for each of the two participants separately.
取结果较高者作为本次黯星实例归属，并冻结其等级基础值。: Take the higher result as the attribution of this Nova instance and freeze its level base value.
计算该归属角色环合强度与心灵穿透。: Compute the attributed character's Cycle Intensity and Mental penetration.
乘受击目标的心灵抗性和易伤后取整。: Multiply by the target's Mental RES and vulnerability, then round.
比较两名环合参与者各自的“等级基础值 × 环合强度”并取较高者；不同触发实例分别: Compare each of the two Cycle participants' "level base value × Cycle Intensity" and take the higher one; each trigger instance keeps its own winner.
双方先按各自等级读取黯星源档；胜出实例冻结对应值，80 级为 45,000。: Both sides first read the Nova source tier for their own level; the winning instance freezes the matching value, which is 45,000 at level 80.
双方各取自己的环合强度参与比较；胜出实例只消费胜出者的强度，不相加。: Each side uses its own Cycle Intensity in the comparison; the winning instance consumes only the winner's Intensity, without adding them.
心灵伤害按 100% 防御穿透处理，防御区固定为 1。: Mental DMG is treated as 100% DEF penetration, so the DEF zone is fixed at 1.
心灵穿透取该实例归属角色；心灵抗性与减抗取受击目标。: Mental penetration comes from the instance's attributed character; Mental RES and RES reduction come from the target hit.
取受击目标在结算时点的受到伤害提升。: Takes the target's DMG taken increase at the settlement moment.
黯星不读取攻击面板、通用增伤或暴击。: Nova does not read the ATK panel, generic DMG bonus or CRIT.
多个实例的最终统一结算需保留各实例自己的来源属性，不能把双方环合强度相加后只算一: When settling several instances together, each instance must keep its own source attributes; the two participants' Cycle Intensities must not be added and computed only once.
QTE 触发后持续 12 秒；全队后续逐击分别读取各自伤害来源角色的环合强度。: Lasts 12 seconds after the QTE trigger; each later hit by any ally reads the Cycle Intensity of its own actual damage source character.
本击浸染最终乘区 = 1.20 × [1 + 20% × 本击来源环合强度 /: This hit's Stain final multiplier = 1.20 × [1 + 20% × this hit's source Cycle Intensity / (this hit's source Cycle Intensity + 180)]; benefiting hit = original full damage × this hit's Stain final multiplier
由正式魂+相 QTE 结算确认浸染触发。: Stain's trigger is confirmed by the formal Psyche + Lakshana QTE settlement.
从 QTE 结算后建立 12 秒团队增伤区间；触发 QTE 本击不吃。: A 12-second team DMG bonus window starts after the QTE settlement; the QTE hit that triggered it does not benefit.
区间内每条后续逐击读取该击实际伤害来源角色的环合强度。: Within the window, each later hit reads the Cycle Intensity of that hit's actual damage source character.
在该击原完整公式末端乘对应的浸染最终乘区。: Multiplies the corresponding Stain final multiplier at the end of that hit's original full formula.
只负责触发或刷新浸染状态；其环合强度不会冻结为全队 12 秒共用值。: Only triggers or refreshes the Stain state; their Cycle Intensity is not frozen as a shared 12-second value for the team.
取区间内当前这条受益伤害的实际来源角色；该角色提供本击浸染公式的环合强度。: Takes the actual source character of the current benefiting damage within the window; that character provides the Cycle Intensity for this hit's Stain formula.
取正式环合常量 20%，构成前置 1.20。: Takes the formal Cycle constant of 20%, forming the leading 1.20.
使用本击伤害来源角色的环合强度：1 + 20%×环合强度/(环合强度+180)。: Uses the Cycle Intensity of this hit's damage source character: 1 + 20%×Cycle Intensity/(Cycle Intensity+180).
取正式环合常量 12 秒；从触发 QTE 结算后开始，后续触发刷新区间。: Takes the formal Cycle constant of 12 seconds; it starts after the triggering QTE settlement, and later triggers refresh the window.
队伍所有角色在区间内的后续逐击；不同角色的伤害会因各自环合强度不同而得到不同乘区: All allies' later hits within the window; different characters get different multipliers because their Cycle Intensity differs.
浸染是团队最终增伤 Buff，不生成独立“浸染伤害”，也不记录伤害后在 12 秒: Stain is a team final DMG bonus Buff; it does not generate separate "Stain damage" and does not record damage for a single settlement at the end of 12 seconds.
团队倾陷与非逐击最大生命结算当前不默认消费该最终乘区。: Team Break and non-per-hit max HP settlements do not consume this final multiplier by default.
若逐击不能确认实际伤害来源，状态可以显示，但该击环合强度收益必须保持未解析，不能: If a hit's actual damage source cannot be confirmed, the state may still be shown, but that hit's Cycle Intensity gain must stay unresolved and must not fall back to the QTE triggerer or a neighbouring hit.
相+光；5 秒减攻减速，本身没有伤害公式。: Lakshana + Cosmos; 5 seconds of ATK reduction and slow, with no damage formula of its own.
延滞伤害 = 不适用；状态持续 5 秒: Remora damage = not applicable; the state lasts 5 seconds
对目标建立 5 秒延滞状态。: Apply a 5-second Remora state to the target.
受击目标；后续只有明确要求延滞状态的机制消费。: The target hit; afterwards only mechanics that explicitly require the Remora state consume it.
延滞不生成伤害逐击，不能填入直伤或环合伤害。: Remora does not generate damage hits and must not be filled into direct or Cycle damage.
光+灵+相；创生花命中延滞目标时获得 10 点额外终结能量。: Cosmos + Anima + Lakshana; hitting a target under Remora with a Blossom Flower grants 10 extra Ultimate Energy.
额外终结能量 = 10（创生花命中处于延滞的目标时）: Extra Ultimate Energy = 10 (when a Blossom Flower hits a target under Remora)

暗+魂+咒；目标同时有黯星与浊燃时扣除倾陷值，本身不造成伤害。: Chaos + Psyche + Incantation; when the target has both Nova and Scorch it deducts Break value, and deals no damage itself.
15% 是当前项目弱证据默认值，固定值、等级系数和联机修正仍待确认。: 15% is the current project's weak-evidence default; the fixed value, level coefficient and co-op correction are still unconfirmed.

取同半场、同目标的状态轴，不跨目标拼接。: Takes the state axis of the same target in the same half; never stitches across targets.

三觉提前结算是“逐层剩余跳数求和并清空”的独立公式；当前缺少稳定关联时不得冒充普: The 3rd Awakening early settlement is a separate formula that "sums each stack's remaining ticks and clears them"; without a stable link it must not be passed off as a normal single tick.
取残虹蚀心正式伤害项和当前有效普通攻击技能等级。: Takes Zankou's formal Heartwrench damage entry and the current effective Basic Attack skill level.
正式活跃层数与本跳有效系数分开；只在“单份”或“本击前正式层数”中按实伤选择，最: The formal active stack count and this tick's effective coefficient are kept separate; choose by actual damage only between "a single share" and "the formal stacks before this hit", up to 10 stacks.
不得开放 1–10 任意拟合；缺施加事件时系数 1 仅表示至少一份，并保持低置信: Arbitrary fitting between 1 and 10 must not be offered; with no application event, coefficient 1 means only at least one share and stays low confidence.
取残虹鸩火正式伤害项和当前有效极轨终结技能等级。: Takes Zankou's formal Vile Ash damage entry and the current effective Ultimate skill level.
“血宴入梦时”最终施加点一次加 5 层，最多 10 层、持续 30 秒；普通攻击: "Bloodfeast Reverie" adds 5 stacks at once at its final application point, up to 10 stacks for 30 seconds; Basic Attacks and DOT ticks do not add stacks.
扩散复制层数、剩余时间和周期，但单目标轴不得凭此制造其他目标的伤害逐击。: Spread replicates the stack count, remaining time and period, but a single-target axis must not use this to fabricate damage hits on other targets.
同半场每名角色分别算五乘区，再把所有角色贡献相加。: Each character in the same half computes their own five multipliers, then all characters' contributions are added.
团队倾陷 = Σ同半场角色 i [等级基础_i × (1 + 倾陷强度_i/30: Team Break = Σ over characters i in the same half [level base_i × (1 + Break Intensity_i/300 + Σ Break increase_i) × enemy Break limit zone × DEF zone_i × RES zone_i]
固定本击所在半场的完整出伤角色阵容。: Fixes the complete set of damage-dealing characters for the half this hit belongs to.
每名角色用自己的等级、倾陷强度、属性和穿透单独算一格。: Each character computes their own cell using their own level, Break Intensity, element and penetration.
每格读取同一受击目标的倾陷上限、防御和对应属性抗性。: Each cell reads the Break limit, DEF and matching elemental resistance of the same target hit.
把所有角色格相加，最终向下取整。: Adds all character cells together, then floors at the end.
取本击同半场全部正式出伤角色；Core 挂名的触发角色不是唯一伤害所有者。: Takes every formal damage-dealing character in the same half as this hit; the trigger character named by Core is not the sole damage owner.
每名角色取自己的等级对应官方 1–80 级倾陷曲线；80 级为 3,603。: Each character takes the official level 1–80 Break curve for their own level; it is 3,603 at level 80.
每名角色取自己的“基础×(1+提升)+固定额外”，双方/全队不先合并。: Each character takes their own "base × (1 + increase) + fixed extra"; both sides and the whole team are not merged first.
只进入提供该效果的角色格；倾陷状态本身不会自动提供易伤。: Only enters the character cell that provides the effect; the Break state itself does not automatically provide vulnerability.
取同一受击目标的 UnbalMax；普通为 max(1, UnbalMax/3): Takes UnbalMax from the same target hit; normal is max(1, UnbalMax/3), and the Feast high-tier Boss tier is fixed at 25.
每格用该角色等级和防御穿透，目标防御/减防来自同一受击目标。: Each cell uses that character's level and DEF penetration; the target's DEF/DEF reduction come from the same target hit.
每格按该角色固有伤害属性取自己的穿透，并读取目标对应属性抗性/减抗。: Each cell uses its own penetration for that character's innate damage element and reads the target's matching elemental resistance/RES reduction.
倾陷不读取攻击/生命/防御缩放面板、通用增伤、易伤、暴击或独立最终增伤。: Break does not read ATK/HP/DEF scaling panels, generic DMG bonus, vulnerability, CRIT or independent final bonuses.
半场阵容或目标画像不完整时必须标记不可完整重放，不能从另一半场补齐。: If the half's lineup or the target's profile is incomplete it must be marked as not fully replayable; it must not be completed from the other half.
使用达芙蒂尔个人倾陷五乘区；候选五觉额外次数为 1 + 洞察层数。: Uses Daffodill's personal five Break multipliers; the candidate 5th Awakening extra count is 1 + Insight stacks.
单次个人倾陷 = 达芙蒂尔等级基础 × 达芙蒂尔倾陷强度区 × 目标倾陷上限区: Single personal Break = Daffodill's level base × Daffodill's Break Intensity zone × target's Break limit zone × Daffodill's DEF zone × Chaos RES zone; candidate 5th Awakening total count = 1 + Insight stacks
在已有正式倾陷时点读取洞察层数。: Reads the Insight stacks at the existing formal Break moment.
用达芙蒂尔自己的个人倾陷五乘区算单次值。: Uses Daffodill's own personal five Break multipliers to compute a single value.
零觉已有一次；候选五觉再按每层洞察追加一次。: Awakening 0 already has one; the candidate 5th Awakening adds one more per Insight stack.
等级、倾陷强度、防御穿透、暗属性穿透都取达芙蒂尔，不取团队其他角色。: Level, Break Intensity, DEF penetration and Chaos penetration all come from Daffodill, not from other team characters.
倾陷上限、防御、暗抗与对应减益取本次受击目标。: Break limit, DEF, Chaos RES and the matching debuffs come from this target hit.
取达芙蒂尔专用固定轴状态；三觉前一层，三觉后最多两层。: Takes Daffodill's dedicated fixed-axis state; one stack before the 3rd Awakening and up to two after it.
出现额外倾陷 GE 只证明公式锚点，不自动证明已启用五觉。: The presence of an extra Break GE only proves a formula anchor; it does not automatically prove the 5th Awakening is active.
候选新增行基线为零，不替换原团队倾陷伤害。: The candidate's added row has a baseline of zero and does not replace the original team Break damage.
来源噩梦本体伤害的 200%；有效生命损失再按结算前生命比例折算。: 200% of the source Nightmare's own damage; the effective HP loss is then scaled by the pre-settlement HP ratio.
预计最大生命削减 = 来源噩梦伤害 × 200%；有效生命损失 = 最大生命下降: Estimated max HP reduction = source Nightmare damage × 200%; effective HP loss = max HP reduction × clamp(pre-settlement HP/old max HP, 0, 1)
只绑定正式噩梦逐击，不接受相邻生命样本或普通直伤。: Bound only to formal Nightmare hits; it accepts neither neighbouring HP samples nor ordinary direct damage.
按该来源噩梦的候选/原始公式比联动削减值。: Scales the reduction value by the source Nightmare's candidate/original formula ratio.
按目标结算前生命比例折算为有效伤害。: Converts to effective damage using the target's pre-settlement HP ratio.
取同一目标、归因明确的安魂曲正式噩梦逐击；伤害变化继承该逐击公式比。: Takes Lacrimosa's formal Nightmare hits on the same target with clear attribution; damage changes inherit that hit's formula ratio.
旧/新最大生命和结算前生命都取同半场、同目标的连续生命轴。: Old/new max HP and pre-settlement HP all come from the continuous HP axis of the same target in the same half.
归属安魂曲；目标生命数据只决定有效损失，不改变来源角色。: Attributed to Lacrimosa; the target's HP data only determines the effective loss and does not change the source character.
描述估算与 Core 正式最大生命下降必须分开；缺目标连续轴时保持部分/不可用。: Descriptive estimates and Core's formal max HP reduction must be kept separate; when the target's continuous axis is missing, stay partial/unavailable.
共享法帝娅实际承受伤害的 300%/600%，并受她生命上限的 8%/25% 累: Shares 300%/600% of the damage Fadia actually takes, bounded by a cumulative cap of 8%/25% of her max HP.
本次可共享 = min(法帝娅实际承受伤害 × 共享比例, 累计上限 - 已累计: Shareable this time = min(Fadia's actual damage taken × share ratio, cumulative cap - already accumulated); cumulative cap = Fadia's max HP × cap ratio
先取得法帝娅本次真实承受伤害。: First obtain the damage Fadia actually took this time.
按普通 300%/8% 或二觉 600%/25% 计算。: Compute with the normal 300%/8% or the 2nd Awakening 600%/25%.
受累计上限截断；效果移除时按正式规则补足差额。: Truncated by the cumulative cap; when the effect is removed, the difference is topped up by the formal rules.
只取法帝娅本人经过护盾与队伍分摊后的可靠承伤，不取敌人原始出伤封包。: Takes only the reliable damage Fadia herself takes after shields and team sharing, not the enemy's raw outgoing damage packet.
取法帝娅该机制的普通或二觉分支。: Takes the normal or 2nd Awakening branch of this mechanic for Fadia.
取法帝娅当前生命上限，不取受击敌人或共享目标。: Takes Fadia's current max HP, not the enemy hit or the shared target.
取本次机制实例已共享的历史累计。: Takes the historical total already shared by this mechanic instance.
当前战报承伤证据可能早于护盾/分摊结算；证据不足时不得直接乘 3 或乘 6。: The current battle report's damage-taken evidence may predate the shield/sharing settlement; with insufficient evidence it must not simply be multiplied by 3 or 6.
